title: silene coeli-rosa var. aspera
intro: Silene coeli-rosa var. aspera, commonly known as the rough-stemmed catchfly, is a perennial plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Silene coeli-rosa var. aspera include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic effects.
